name: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake - Silent Hill f Costume Set
summary:
Transform into Shimizu Hinako, the main character from Silent Hill f, with this costume set.

The Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake - Silent Hill f Costume Set includes the following items from Silent Hill f:
- Outfit: Navy Sailor School Uniform
- Accessory: Fox Mask

Players can equip Shimizu Hinako's school uniform and the Fox Mask in game.
The Navy Sailor School Uniform outfit can be worn by Mio Amakura, and the Fox Mask accessory can be worn by Mio Amakura and Mayu Amakura.
